body:
Please add WOWII Conjecture 353 (18 February 2009) with its written disproof: Jonas J. Gebendorfer, *An infinite family of counterexamples to Written on the Wall II Conjecture 353*.

For a tree T of order greater than two, let D2 be its degree-two vertices, M its maximum-degree vertices, c the number of induced components, and k_M the order of a largest component of T[M]. The proposed bound is gamma_t(T) >= c(T[D2]) + k_M/2. It is false.

**Complete witness.** Labels a,b,c,x,y are 0,1,2,3,4. Start with edges 01,12,13,34. For i=0,1,2,3 introduce v,u,l,w,z=5+5i,...,9+5i and add root-v, v-u, u-l, u-w, w-z; root=0 for i<2 and root=2 otherwise. No other edges. This is a connected 25-vertex tree with 24 edges. Degrees are nine ones, nine twos and seven threes. The degree-two vertices {3,5,8,10,13,15,18,20,23} are independent; maximum-degree vertices induce the path 0-1-2 and four isolated vertices. Thus c=9 and k_M=3.

Every total dominating set contains F={3,6,8,11,13,16,18,21,23}, since these are neighbors of leaves. F alone fails to dominate vertex3. Adding vertex1 produces a total dominating set of order10. Hence gamma_t=10 < 21/2, refuting the printed inequality. The optimal set is unique. The paper proves an infinite family for every maximum degree d>=3, with n=2d^2+4d-5, gamma_t=5d-5, c=5d-6 and k_M=3; no minimum-order claim is made.

Fresh execution independently reconstructed this graph, checked it by tree DP, and enumerated all 65,536 supersets of F. Exactly 41,984 are total dominating, and exactly one optimum has size10.

Source: [DeLaViña's WOWII archive](https://cms.uhd.edu/faculty/delavinae/research/wowII/open.html), with linked definitions, and the preserved [public HTML-row dataset](https://gitlab.com/ai-village-agents/village/graffiti-verification/-/blob/main/data/wow2_rows_html.json). Historical O and secondary transcriptions are not a current curator decision. No worldwide first-priority or independent external review is claimed.

The attachment contains the full six manuscripts by Jonas J. Gebendorfer (13 October 2026), a newly reconstructed standard-library verifier, its executed output, preserved source records and a SHA256 manifest. Run `python3 audit_new_manuscripts.py`. This is a fresh diagnostic, not a claim to have recovered or rerun the papers' originally described supplements. Finite checks are not proof premises. OpenAI Codex assisted with source comparison, proof reading, reconstruction and submission under the author's direction.

[Gebendorfer_New_Proofs_Intakes_2026-10-14.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/33421512/Gebendorfer_New_Proofs_Intakes_2026-10-14.zip)

comments.body:
Update, 14 October 2026: PR #7310 adds the statement and links a complete kernel-checked Lean disproof.

Immutable proof, exact-type audit and reproduction instructions: https://github.com/RhudeJJJJ/formal-conjectures/tree/c9f7e9b894fc0c979b57891f976c59f2b432273f/Proofs

Both proof and separate audit compiled without warnings on Lean4.33.1 / the pinned Mathlib. All eight audited declarations use only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound, with no sorryAx or native-evaluation trust. The exact proposed statement module passes lake --wfail build. Published blobs match the locally executed files.

The certificate proves that the 25-vertex witness is a tree, admits a total dominating set of order10, has nine degree-two components and a maximum-degree component of order at least3. These are sufficient to refute the full universal inequality. Exact optimality, uniqueness and the infinite-family formulas remain separate written results. Maintainer review remains pending.

title: WOWII 353: an explicit 25-vertex total-domination counterexample
